counting_policy: Count implemented primary families and compression formats, merging aliases and variants. Declaration families and nested structures are separate. Implementation counts are not universal format or platform qualification claims.

formats.name: ELF
formats.profile: ELF32/64 structure, dynamic dependencies, symbols, notes and hardening; not general instruction behavior.
limitations: Only the documented profile is implemented; see docs/LIMITATIONS.md and the linked source/qualification records.
This catalogue entry does not claim every variant or platform has independent real-sample qualification.

formats.name: Arch Linux package
formats.profile: ALPM metadata, literal dependencies and install declarations, captured TAR payload/link evidence.
limitations: Selected ALPM key = value metadata and bounded literal install-script text; no host or repository dependency resolution.
Package authentication and MTREE checksums are not verified. Links remain source declarations.

formats.name: Unix ar archive
formats.profile: Bounded archive members and indexes; thin references are recorded without host-file access.
limitations: GNU/BSD ordinary archive members and GNU32/64 index declarations are read under fixed budgets.
BSD/COFF index semantics remain unread. Thin members retain references only; no external file is opened.

formats.name: Alpine Linux package
formats.profile: Alpine APK v2 exact gzip members, control identity/dependencies/scripts and separately captured payload declarations.
limitations: APK v3/ADB and unsupported TAR profiles remain unread. Signature bytes and gzip integrity do not establish package authenticity. Scripts are never run.

formats.name: Flatpak single-file bundle
formats.profile: Full single-file Flatpak bundles with empty-base OSTree inline V0 stored/XZ literal operations, checked objects and application declarations.
limitations: Other base/fallback/opcode profiles are explicit limitations. No importing, installation, runtime loading or signature-trust claim.

formats.name: OCI/Docker image family
formats.profile: One OCI/Docker-save family: captured manifest/configuration, checked SHA-256 descriptors, ordered separate layers and whiteout/link declarations.
limitations: No registry lookup, merged filesystem, image execution or signature trust. Global PAX, sparse and unfinished layer TAR profiles remain unsupported.

formats.name: LZ4 framed stream
formats.profile: One modern independent-block LZ4 frame, bounded stored/compressed decoding with optional content size and declared checksums.
limitations: Linked blocks, external dictionaries, legacy/raw/skippable and concatenated streams are unsupported. Checksums do not authenticate contents.

formats.name: systemd unit

Supplied Desktop Entry identity relationships do not establish runtime command selection.
